name: AI/BI Patient Genomics Review for Oncology
narrative:
You're a translational oncology lead deciding where a new targeted therapy, OncoTarget-1, actually belongs. Across a ~10,000-patient cohort the drug shows only a modest overall survival edge — but a flat average hides the truth, and using it everywhere would help some patients and harm others.

The dashboard breaks the lift apart by cancer, showing where it helps and where it's not indicated (Ovary, Prostate). Ask Genie which subgroup benefits most and the answer isn't an organ — it's a molecular gene-expression subtype in breast cancer, reaching ~99% survival versus ~84% on standard of care.
